sentiment.rationale: This is a pre-earnings digest, so the guidance-change framework does not apply. Instead, the document describes market expectations that are unusually stretched to the upside: buy-side analysts expect subscriber adds well above sell-side consensus, with 70% calling for at least 11.1 million net adds versus Wall Street's 9.2 million, and 29% predicting north of 13.1 million. The document also notes the stock has already recovered ahead of earnings. This elevated bar and 'priced for perfection' positioning increases the risk of a negative surprise even on decent results, warranting a mildly bearish sentiment score.
